summary.text: Chris Reid is the Democratic candidate for Utah House of Representatives District 1 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Thomas Peterson (R) and Jason O'Dell of the Constitution Party.
He advanced from the April 25, 2026 Democratic convention, and the June 23 Democratic primary was canceled.

paragraphs.text: Chris Reid also sought the Democratic nomination for District 1 in 2024, when Claudia Bigler defeated him at the April 27, 2024 Democratic convention, 3 votes to 0.
